matches.notes: Played well, felt like the deck was balanced well and that I had strong units and counters to both opponents. Super buffing my chosen Ambessa helped clear multiple units from ivern, even with Vilemaw thanks to killing a unit when attacking. Viktor wasn't much of an issue except for Cull the weak which harmed my setups and ramping pretty bad.

This was a very close game with The Grand Plaza, both opponents conquered with over 7 units so hail mary was done from both me and Ivern player to prevent the insta win on hold. This game was super close ended with all players on 7 points and Ivern winning due to a late Vilemaw being uncontested for holding. This game was hard for me due to good RNG from Viktor with counters to my Lacerate and with 2 Cull the Weak preventing me from having units and leaving me with no cards in hand towards end game.

Loads of units with assault making it hard to hold battlefields. Probably played a bit poorly to be fair but also found a surplus of units the last round with no spells and therefore lack of removal, buffing and setup. Felt like I had loads of cheap options,  but not much to help me take control of the game and bounce back from early missplays or being countered.
Felt in control the whole game and got a really good run with the new deck. Felt in control the whole game and was able to both conquer and deal with his build up of units alright.
Played against a newbie, felt in control the whole game again with good draws, constant units and spells to help counter hsi pushes and buildups.

I was really unlucky with the draws here, and if we played bo3 it likely would have ended differently the other 2 games. Played heavy holding and I had to trade units often to prevent double points. Lucky draws for him let him kill more of my units and I was unable to come back with only spells in hand.
Taught my friend to play the game and really got to test the deck. I was easily able to build up units due to his lack of kill and removal spells. Felt in control the whole game.

I was trying it out for the first time and was really going for the yasuo strategy. It didnt work and I got run over and never really got my footing. Some spells and gear on his side killed my early build up of units.

I played for the first time into Leblanc. He had so many units with deathknell tags and played Karthus as well so constantly had great drawing and channeling. First round was kind of easy, then the second very close, and due to only drawing units and no useful spells last game I was on the backfoot the whole time. Felt like I had to use loads of resources to prevent him from getting infinite cards and then I would lose. Also the constant pressure of hidden blade and cull the weak was immense

Pretty standard rumble deck, felt in control most of the time and was able t use Rengar units well. Both rounds ended 8-7 but to be honest I felt ahead at all times. Definitely some clunky drawing at certain points. Feels like there are heaps of weaker units that dont do much once early game is done.

Super clunky draws, pure units almost no spells and once I had them I was defied anyways. Both rounds the yasuo got super good early game, double conquering anhd being at 3 or 4 points by turn 3 pretty confidently. Didnt have many asnwers early and took a while to build up. Clunky draws for sure.
